subcommittees.name: Coast Guard and Maritime Transportation Subcommittee

dimensions.assessment: Affects U.S. port authorities and operators applying for Port Infrastructure Development Program grants.
dimensions.evidence: projects to upgrade or replace port cranes or parts of port cranes (including hardware and software)

dimensions.assessment: Allows existing grant money to be directed toward replacing specific foreign-provided infrastructure equipment.
dimensions.evidence: that were installed or provided by the People's Republic of China

dimensions.assessment: Directs how existing Port Infrastructure Development Program grant funds may be allocated, without creating new appropriations.
dimensions.evidence: clarify that port infrastructure development program funds may be used to replace Chinese port crane hardware or software

dimensions.assessment: Narrowly amends a single section of Title 46 regarding eligible expenses under an existing grant program.
dimensions.evidence: Section 54301(a)(3)(A)(ii)(III) of title 46, United States Code, is amended

dimensions.assessment: Permanent statutory clarification for federal port grant eligibility.

missing_information: Total amount of grant funds that will be redirected toward crane replacement.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill clarifies that existing Port Infrastructure Development Program funds can be used to upgrade or replace Chinese-provided port cranes and related hardware or software, providing a specific new category of eligible grant spending for U.S. ports.
